threshold_rationale.selected_measure: FY2024 median FFS Medicare margin for relatively efficient hospitals
threshold_rationale.rationale: Health/Medicare adequacy and resilience floors should prevent a lower-cost payment scenario from being treated as admissible if reviewed policy and stress evidence push relatively efficient hospitals below the FY2024 median FFS Medicare margin baseline before access, quality, rural/safety-net, behavior, incidence, transition, and federal translation evidence are ready.
threshold_rationale.source_table: Health target admissibility hospital care anchor sourced to MedPAC March 2026 payment-policy context

primary_baseline.measure: relatively efficient hospital median FFS Medicare margin

supporting_context.measure: efficient hospital projected 2026 median FFS Medicare margin

baseline_values.boundary: The efficient-hospital margin baseline is provider-adequacy context only. It is not a universal Medicare-relative target, not a federal policy score, not a gross payment effect, not net savings, not access-floor passage, not quality-floor passage, not rural/safety-net capacity evidence, not behavior or incidence modeling, not transition cost, not solver input, and not a balanced-budget claim.

remaining_requirements: quality and risk-adjusted outcome floor values
pass/fail evidence comparing policy and stress values with the threshold
